Visitor skips form elements entirely

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

type testVisitorVisitorFormSkip struct{
	htmd.BaseVisitor
}
func (v *testVisitorVisitorFormSkip) VisitForm(ctx htmd.NodeContext, action *string, method *string) htmd.VisitResult {
	return htmd.VisitResultSkip()
}

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	visitor := &testVisitorVisitorFormSkip{}
	options.Visitor = visitor
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<p>Before form</p><form><input type="email" name="email"></form><p>After form</p>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
```
